newsitem.title: USA: National Beverage in alliance with Supervalu.
newsitem.headline: National Beverage in alliance with Supervalu.

text.p: National Beverage Corp said it entered a long-term strategic alliance with food wholesaler and distributor Supervalu Inc.
Terms of the alliance and specific details were not disclosed. A spokesman from the company declined to comment.

The alliance will ensure that National Beverage's branded beverage products, including Shasta and Everfresh, will be distributed through SUPERVALU, the spokesman said. The alliance will increase National Beverage's core business by more than $150 million in revenue during the length of the alliance, he added.

Supervalu had sales of more than $16 billion in its last fiscal year, and serves more than 4,100 independent retail outlets and more than 1,000 supermarkets in the U.S., according to National Beverage.
